problem: An XY-plane MPOLYGON moved by +3 in Z falls back to HATCH with a loss note. The candidate wrote HATCH elevation as zero and discarded nonzero HATCH elevation on reopen. A new generated regression failed six vertex-Z assertions, three per ASCII/Binary output, before the fix.

authority.title: Autodesk HATCH DXF group codes
authority.scope: Group 30 holds the HATCH elevation point in OCS; group 210 is the extrusion direction. The patch only maps the default (0,0,1) normal.

patch.application: git apply --check PASS on the exact already-patched candidate; this is a downstream incremental patch, not a standalone patch on upstream master. No user LibreCAD_3 checkout was changed.
patch.changes: For a default-normal HATCH, import group-30 elevation into polyline vertex Z. On output, only for a single closed polyline loop with default extrusion, zero polyline elevation/thickness, and a finite identical vertex Z, write that Z as HATCH group 30. This covers the reported MPOLYGON fallback and a subsequent ordinary HATCH resave. Mixed/nonfinite Z and other profiles do not infer a single elevation; the prior MPOLYGON loss note remains.

validation.selectedTests: 3/3 PASS in each codec build: new generated lift ASCII/Binary save/reopen/resave, mixed-Z fallback control and same-document corrected retry; existing simple MPOLYGON and rotation/bulge tests. The older codec follows its existing HATCH fallback path.
validation.lineTests: 2/2 PASS in each codec build: generated ASCII 2D LINE open/save and generated AC1015 3D LINE save/reopen. The 2D case does not reopen its output.
validation.releaseInventory: 1350 tracked source-release files; generator check and 18-control self-test pass. No DWG/DXF fixture was added or committed.

bundledCodec.build: candidate CMake bundled-codec path with system codec disabled; archive is linked into persistence

limitations: Downstream patch and prior candidate are unmerged; no GUI, native CAD rendering or native producer drawing has been qualified.

Only one closed polyline loop and default normal are handled on export; nonplanar or tilted geometry, edge paths, multiple loops, polyline-owned nonzero elevation/thickness, and nonfinite Z do not acquire a synthesized elevation. The mixed-Z fallback remains lossy and retains its warning.
A HATCH fallback still loses MPOLYGON-specific information, and 3D MPOLYGON edit support is not claimed.
Scratch logs and generated files are ephemeral; no fixture was committed. P8-D remains open.
